description: This dataset captures fish physiological metrics from Macapule Lagoon, recording samples across different seasons and dates. It includes detailed biological measurements such as mass, organ weights, and biochemical markers like cholesterol and glucose. Derived indices such as HSI and GRI provide insights into fish condition and health. The data allows researchers to analyze seasonal variations in fish physiology and metabolic status. By linking individual codes with spatial coordinates, users can track specific specimens and correlate physiological changes with environmental factors. This resource is valuable for ecological studies focusing on fish health, energy reserves, and seasonal adaptation patterns in marine environments.
